info.title: trakr
info.description: Launch monitor bridge for golf simulators. Discover a launch monitor, connect, arm it, and stream shot events. This same API backs the trakr CLI and the trakr Tauri UI, so anything the UI can do, an agent can do by calling this API directly.

get.summary: Discover launch monitors on the network
get.description: Broadcasts a discovery request on every active local network interface (WiFi or wired) automatically and collects replies for `window_ms`. Does not require or affect an active session.

parameters.name: broadcast
parameters.description: Comma-separated extra directed broadcast address(es) to scan, beyond the ones auto-detected from this host's own network interfaces. Only needed for a network this host isn't itself on.

example.help: no launch monitor is connected. POST /v1/session to connect

post.description: Idempotent: calling this again for the same device is a no-op. Connecting to a second device while one is active returns 409 — call DELETE /v1/session first.

name.description: Box name from GET /v1/devices. Omit with address to auto-discover the first box found.

address.description: Box IPv4 address. Required together with name.

broadcast.description: Extra directed broadcast address(es) to scan if auto-discovering, beyond this host's own network interfaces.

202.description: Connecting; poll GET /v1/session or stream GET /v1/events

409.description: A different session is already active

delete.description: Idempotent: returns 200 even if no session was active.

post.description: Activates lasers/cameras and puts the device in a waiting-for-shot state.

get.description: text/event-stream. Each event's `event:` line is one of discovered, connected, disconnected, status, ready, shot_started, shot, misread, error; `data:` is the JSON-serialized trakr_core::Event with a matching "type" field. Consume with `curl -N http://127.0.0.1:7011/v1/events` or any SSE/EventSource client.
